bio.text: Jon Echols, a Republican, is a candidate for Oklahoma Attorney General in the November 3, 2026 election, having advanced from the June 16 Republican primary.
He represented District 90 in the Oklahoma House of Representatives from November 21, 2012, to November 20, 2024.
Echols earned a B.S. in political science from the University of Oklahoma and a J.D. from Oklahoma City University.
